Script.name: m_aarchaeology_main
Script.script:
-- Mudlet port of Endymion's Aarchaeology 2 MUSHclient plugin. m_aarchaeology = m_aarchaeology or {} local A = m_aarchaeology
A.version = "1.3.0" A.default_settings = { bags = "'collection satchel'", sounds = "on", sound_file = "C:\\Windows\\Media\\Cityscape\\Windows Feed Discovered.wav", fallback_multiplier = 5, }
A.pieces = { "Johnny's Appleseed", "An Ancient Skull", "A Golden Truffle", "An Ancient Game Token", "Neptune's Retired Staff", "Percival's Retired Crown", "Photo of an F1 Tornado", "A Ring of Thandeld", "Petrified Volcano Ash", "An Old Coyote's Tooth", "Dorothy's Lost Earring", "A Golden Cross", "Skeleton of a Goblin", "A Rusted Coin", "A Rusted Trumpet", "A Coffin Lid", "A Wedding Ring", "A Dinosaur Bone", "A Dragon's Tooth", "Unknown Element", "A Destroyed Mosaic", "A Silver Cross", "Lost Binoculars", "Pirate's Hat", "A Rusted Cleaver", "Wilted Rose", "Casino Chip", "Torn Visitor's Pass", "Ten-year-old Textbook", "Ivory Tusks", "An Oasis", "Skeleton of a Monkey", "An Ancient Stalactite", "Shoes of a Gnome", "A Torn Peace Agreement", "Chunk of an Iceberg", "Wings of a Harpy", "Petrified Tree Branch", "A Golden Leaf", "Writings of a Dream", "An Old Rope", "A Broken Twig", "Brick from a Castle", "A Rusted Belt Buckle", "A Biblical Textbook", "Frozen Flames", "Fox Tooth", "Picture of a Forest", "Moon in a Bottle", "Rotting Reed", }
A.values = { "10k", "10k", "10k", "10k", "10k", "50k", "50k", "50k", "50k", "50k", "100k", "100k", "100k", "100k", "100k", "250k", "250k", "250k", "250k", "250k", "500k", "500k", "500k", "500k", "500k", "750k", "750k", "750k", "750k", "750k", "1mil", "1mil", "1mil", "1mil", "1mil", "2mil", "2mil", "2mil", "2mil", "2mil", "2mil", "5mil", "5mil", "5mil", "10mil", "10mil", "TP", "TP", "TP", "TP", }
local function trim(value) return tostring(value or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") end
local function normalize(value) local text = tostring(value or "") text = text:gsub("@.", "") text = text:gsub("<[^>]+>", "") text = text:gsub("%([Aa]archaeology%)", "") text = text:gsub("%.%.%.$", "") text = text:gsub("%s+", " ") text = trim(text):lower() if text == "chunk of an iceburg" then text = "chunk of an iceberg" end return text end
local function clone_defaults() return { bags = A.default_settings.bags, sounds = A.default_settings.sounds, sound_file = A.default_settings.sound_file, fallback_multiplier = A.default_settings.fallback_multiplier, } end
local function persistence_dir() local home = type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" and getMudletHomeDir() or "." local dir = home .. "/persistence" if type(mkdir) == "function" then pcall(mkdir, dir) end if type(lfs) == "table" and type(lfs.mkdir) == "function" then pcall(lfs.mkdir, dir) end return dir end
A.state_file = persistence_dir() .. "/m_aarchaeology_state.lua" A.mbot_db_file = persistence_dir() .. "/mmarket.db"
function A.load_settings() A.settings = clone_defaults() A.saved_piece_counts = {} A.saved_pamphlet_counts = {} A.has_saved_inventory = false A.inventory_saved_at = nil local ok, loaded = pcall(dofile, A.state_file) if not ok or type(loaded) ~= "table" then return end if type(loaded.bags) == "string" and trim(loaded.bags) ~= "" then A.settings.bags = loaded.bags end if loaded.sounds == "on" or loaded.sounds == "off" then A.settings.sounds = loaded.sounds end if type(loaded.sound_file) == "string" and loaded.sound_file ~= "" then A.settings.sound_file = loaded.sound_file end local multiplier = tonumber(loaded.fallback_multiplier) if multiplier and multiplier > 0 and multiplier <= 1000 then A.settings.fallback_multiplier = multiplier end if loaded.inventory_saved == true then A.saved_piece_counts = A.decode_saved_counts(loaded.piece_counts) A.saved_pamphlet_counts = A.decode_saved_counts(loaded.pamphlet_counts) A.has_saved_inventory = true A.inventory_saved_at = tonumber(loaded.inventory_saved_at) A.restore_saved_inventory() end end
function A.save_settings() local f = io.open(A.state_file, "w") if not f then cecho("<red>[m_aarchaeology] Could not save settings.\n") return false end f:write("return {\n") f:write(" bags = ", string.format("%q", A.settings.bags), ",\n") f:write(" sounds = ", string.format("%q", A.settings.sounds), ",\n") f:write(" sound_file = ", string.format("%q", A.settings.sound_file), ",\n") f:write(" fallback_multiplier = ", tostring(tonumber(A.settings.fallback_multiplier) or 5), ",\n") f:write(" inventory_saved = ", tostring(A.has_saved_inventory == true), ",\n") if A.inventory_saved_at then f:write(" inventory_saved_at = ", tostring(math.floor(A.inventory_saved_at)), ",\n") end f:write(" piece_counts = {\n") for number, piece in ipairs(A.pieces) do local amount = math.floor(tonumber(A.saved_piece_counts and A.saved_piece_counts[piece]) or 0) if amount > 0 then f:write(string.format(" [%d] = %d,\n", number, amount)) end end f:write(" },\n") f:write(" pamphlet_counts = {\n") for number, piece in ipairs(A.pieces) do local amount = math.floor(tonumber(A.saved_pamphlet_counts and A.saved_pamphlet_counts[piece]) or 0) if amount > 0 then f:write(string.format(" [%d] = %d,\n", number, amount)) end end f:write(" },\n") f:write("}\n") f:close() return true end
function A.rebuild_indexes() A.number_by_name = {} A.canonical_by_key = {} for number, piece in ipairs(A.pieces) do A.number_by_name[piece] = number A.canonical_by_key[normalize(piece)] = piece end end
function A.clear_inventory() A.owned = {} A.piece_counts = {} A.pamphlet_counts = {} end
local function copy_counts(source) local result = {} for _, piece in ipairs(A.pieces) do local amount = math.floor(tonumber(source and source[piece]) or 0) if amount > 0 then result[piece] = amount end end return result end
function A.decode_saved_counts(source) local result = {} if type(source) ~= "table" then return result end for key, value in pairs(source) do local number = tonumber(key) local canonical = number and A.pieces[number] or A.canonical_by_key[normalize(key)] local amount = math.floor(tonumber(value) or 0) if canonical and amount > 0 then result[canonical] = amount end end return result end
function A.restore_saved_inventory() A.clear_inventory() A.piece_counts = copy_counts(A.saved_piece_counts) A.pamphlet_counts = copy_counts(A.saved_pamphlet_counts) for _, piece in ipairs(A.pieces) do if (tonumber(A.piece_counts[piece]) or 0) > 0 or (tonumber(A.pamphlet_counts[piece]) or 0) > 0 then A.owned[piece] = true end end A.ran = A.has_saved_inventory == true end
function A.commit_inventory() A.saved_piece_counts = copy_counts(A.piece_counts) A.saved_pamphlet_counts = copy_counts(A.pamphlet_counts) A.has_saved_inventory = true A.inventory_saved_at = os.time() A.ran = true return A.save_settings() end
function A.resolve_candidates(value) local key = normalize(value) if key == "" then return {} end local exact = A.canonical_by_key[key] if exact then return { exact } end
local found = {} for _, piece in ipairs(A.pieces) do local candidate = normalize(piece) if candidate:sub(1, #key) == key or key:sub(1, #candidate) == candidate then found[#found + 1] = piece end end return found end
function A.is_needed(value) local candidates = A.resolve_candidates(value) if #candidates == 0 then return false, candidates end for _, piece in ipairs(candidates) do if not A.owned[piece] then return true, candidates end end return false, candidates end
local function count_label(number, singular, plural) number = tonumber(number) or 0 if number == 0 then return "" end return tostring(number) .. " " .. (number == 1 and singular or plural) end
function A.status_for(value) local candidates = A.resolve_candidates(value) if #candidates == 0 then return "UNK" end local statuses = {} for _, piece in ipairs(candidates) do local pc = tonumber(A.piece_counts[piece]) or 0 local pam = tonumber(A.pamphlet_counts[piece]) or 0 local parts = {} if pc > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = count_label(pc, "Pc", "Pcs") end if pam > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = count_label(pam, "Pam", "Pams") end statuses[#statuses + 1] = #parts > 0 and table.concat(parts, "/") or "NEED" end return table.concat(statuses, "|") end
function A.turnin_for(value) local candidates = A.resolve_candidates(value) if #candidates == 0 then return "?" end local values = {} for _, piece in ipairs(candidates) do values[#values + 1] = A.values[A.number_by_name[piece]] or "?" end return table.concat(values, "|") end
local function current_line(raw_line) if raw_line ~= nil and raw_line ~= "" then return tostring(raw_line) end if type(getCurrentLine) == "function" then local ok, value = pcall(getCurrentLine) if ok then return tostring(value or "") end end return "" end
-- Re-rendering the current line preserves its existing colours and adds the tag -- inline. This is the same Mudlet-safe strategy used by g_Fantasy_Cards_Mudlet. function A.append_inline(raw_line, decho_markup, plain_text, red_fallback) local raw = current_line(raw_line) if type(copy2decho) == "function" and type(decho) == "function" and type(replace) == "function" then local ok_copy, coloured = pcall(copy2decho) if ok_copy and coloured ~= nil and tostring(coloured) ~= "" then coloured = tostring(coloured):gsub("[\r\n]+$", "") local cleared = false if type(selectCurrentLine) == "function" then local ok_select = pcall(selectCurrentLine) cleared = ok_select and pcall(replace, "") or false elseif raw ~= "" and type(selectString) == "function" then local ok_select, position = pcall(selectString, raw, 1) if ok_select and position and position > -1 then cleared = pcall(replace, "") end end if cleared then decho(coloured .. decho_markup .. "<r>\n") return end end end
if red_fallback and type(fg) == "function" and type(echo) == "function" then echo(" ") fg("red") echo(plain_text) if type(resetFormat) == "function" then resetFormat() end return end echo(" " .. plain_text) end
function A.append_need(raw_line) A.append_inline(raw_line, " <255,0,0>NEED", "NEED", true) end
local function echo_lbid_need_link(auction_id) local id = tostring(auction_id or ""):match("^(%d+)$") if not id then return false end local hint = "Click to send: lbid " .. id local callback = function() send("lbid " .. id) end local command = string.format("send(%q)", "lbid " .. id)
if type(cechoLink) == "function" then local ok = pcall(cechoLink, "<red> [NEED]<reset>", callback, hint, true) if not ok then ok = pcall(cechoLink, "<red> [NEED]<reset>", command, hint, true) end if ok then return true end end if type(echoLink) == "function" then if type(fg) == "function" then fg("red") end local ok = pcall(echoLink, " [NEED]", callback, hint, true) if not ok then ok = pcall(echoLink, " [NEED]", command, hint, true) end if type(resetFormat) == "function" then resetFormat() end if ok then return true end end return false end
local function echo_average_tag(tag) if tag and tag ~= "" then cecho(" <yellow>[" .. tag .. "]<reset>") end end
local function echo_plain_need() if type(fg) == "function" and type(echo) == "function" then echo(" ") fg("red") echo("[NEED]") if type(resetFormat) == "function" then resetFormat() end elseif type(cecho) == "function" then cecho(" <red>[NEED]<reset>") else echo(" [NEED]") end end
function A.append_clickable_need(raw_line, auction_id, average_tag) local raw = current_line(raw_line) local rerendered = false if type(copy2decho) == "function" and type(decho) == "function" and type(replace) == "function" then local ok_copy, coloured = pcall(copy2decho) if ok_copy and coloured ~= nil and tostring(coloured) ~= "" then coloured = tostring(coloured):gsub("[\r\n]+$", "") local cleared = false if type(selectCurrentLine) == "function" then local ok_select = pcall(selectCurrentLine) cleared = ok_select and pcall(replace, "") or false elseif raw ~= "" and type(selectString) == "function" then local ok_select, position = pcall(selectString, raw, 1) if ok_select and position and position > -1 then cleared = pcall(replace, "") end end if cleared then decho(coloured) rerendered = true end end end
if not echo_lbid_need_link(auction_id) then echo_plain_need() end echo_average_tag(average_tag) if rerendered then echo("\n") end end
function A.append_piece_details(raw_line, piece) local candidates = A.resolve_candidates(piece) if #candidates == 0 then return end local number = A.number_by_name[candidates[1]] local value = A.turnin_for(piece) local plain = string.format("[Pamphlet #%s] [%s]", tostring(number or "?"), value) local markup = string.format(" <255,0,255>[<0,255,255>Pamphlet <255,255,255>#%s<255,0,255>] [<0,255,255>%s<255,0,255>]", tostring(number or "?"), value) A.append_inline(raw_line, markup, plain, false) end
function A.append_sale_details(raw_line, piece) local status = A.status_for(piece) if status == "UNK" then return end local value = A.turnin_for(piece) local status_rgb = status:find("NEED", 1, true) and "255,0,0" or "0,255,255" local plain = string.format("[%s] [%s]", value, status) local markup = string.format(" <255,0,255>[<0,255,255>%s<255,0,255>] [<%s>%s<255,0,255>]", value, status_rgb, status) A.append_inline(raw_line, markup, plain, false) end
function A.capture_piece(count, piece, raw_line) local candidates = A.resolve_candidates(piece) if #candidates == 0 then return end local canonical = candidates[1] if A.scan_in_progress then local amount = tonumber(count) or 1 A.owned[canonical] = true A.piece_counts[canonical] = (tonumber(A.piece_counts[canonical]) or 0) + amount end A.append_piece_details(raw_line, canonical) end
function A.capture_pamphlet(count, number) if not A.scan_in_progress then return end local canonical = A.pieces[tonumber(number)] if not canonical then return end local amount = tonumber(count) or 1 A.owned[canonical] = true A.pamphlet_counts[canonical] = (tonumber(A.pamphlet_counts[canonical]) or 0) + amount end
function A.market_list(piece, auction_id, raw_line) local needed, candidates = A.is_needed(piece) if #candidates == 0 or not needed then return end local missing_piece = nil for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do if not A.owned[candidate] then missing_piece = candidate; break end end local average_tag = missing_piece and A.average_tag_for_piece(missing_piece) or nil A.append_clickable_need(raw_line, auction_id, average_tag) end
local function split_bags(value) local result = {} for bag in tostring(value or ""):gmatch("([^,]+)") do bag = trim(bag) if bag ~= "" then result[#result + 1] = bag end end return result end
function A.show_bags() local bags = split_bags(A.settings.bags) local label = #bags == 1 and "bag" or "bags" cecho(string.format("<yellow>[m_aarchaeology] Aarch %s set to:\n", label)) for _, bag in ipairs(bags) do cecho(" <cyan>" .. bag .. "\n") end end
function A.set_bags(value) value = trim(value) if value ~= "" then A.settings.bags = value A.save_settings() end A.show_bags() end
local function multiplier_text(value) local number = tonumber(value) or 5 if number == math.floor(number) then return tostring(math.floor(number)) end return tostring(number) end
function A.set_multiplier(value) value = trim(value) if value == "" then cecho("<yellow>[m_aarchaeology] Missing-history fallback multiplier: <white>x" .. multiplier_text(A.settings.fallback_multiplier) .. "<yellow>.\n") return end local number = tonumber(value) if not number or number <= 0 or number > 1000 then cecho("<red>[m_aarchaeology] Multiplier must be a number greater than 0 and no more than 1000.\n") return end A.settings.fallback_multiplier = number A.save_settings() A.sales_cache = nil cecho("<yellow>[m_aarchaeology] Missing-history fallback multiplier set to <white>x" .. multiplier_text(number) .. "<yellow>.\n") end
function A.set_sound_toggle(value) value = tostring(value or ""):lower() if value ~= "on" and value ~= "off" then cecho("<red>[m_aarchaeology] Use: aarch sound on|off\n") return end A.settings.sounds = value A.save_settings() cecho(string.format("<yellow>[m_aarchaeology] Professor alert is <cyan>%s<yellow>.\n", value)) end
function A.set_sound_file(value) value = trim(value) local f = io.open(value, "rb") if not f then cecho("<red>[m_aarchaeology] Invalid sound file: <white>" .. value .. "\n") return end f:close() A.settings.sound_file = value A.save_settings() cecho("<yellow>[m_aarchaeology] Alert sound: <cyan>" .. value .. "\n") end
local function sound_file_exists(path) local file = io.open(tostring(path or ""), "rb") if not file then return false end file:close() return true end
function A.show_sound() local path = A.settings.sound_file local availability = sound_file_exists(path) and "<green>file found" or "<red>file missing" cecho("<yellow>[m_aarchaeology] Professor alert: <cyan>" .. A.settings.sounds .. "<yellow>.\n") cecho("<yellow>[m_aarchaeology] Sound file: <white>" .. path .. " <gray>(" .. availability .. "<gray>)<reset>\n") cecho("<gray> Use <cyan>aarch sound test<gray> to play it now.<reset>\n") end
function A.play_configured_sound() local path = A.settings and A.settings.sound_file or "" if not sound_file_exists(path) then return false, "configured sound file is missing" end if type(playSoundFile) == "function" then local ok, result = pcall(playSoundFile, { name = path, volume = 100 }) if ok and result ~= false then return true end ok, result = pcall(playSoundFile, path, 100) if ok and result ~= false then return true end ok, result = pcall(playSoundFile, path) if ok and result ~= false then return true end end if type(playSound) == "function" then local ok, result = pcall(playSound, path) if ok and result ~= false then return true end end return false, "Mudlet could not play the configured file" end
function A.play_professor_sound() if not A.settings or A.settings.sounds ~= "on" then return end A.play_configured_sound() end
function A.test_sound() local ok, reason = A.play_configured_sound() if ok then cecho("<green>[m_aarchaeology] Played the configured Professor alert.\n") else cecho("<red>[m_aarchaeology] Sound test failed: <white>" .. tostring(reason or "unknown error") .. "<reset>\n") end end
local function comma_number(number) local text = tostring(math.floor((tonumber(number) or 0) + 0.5)) while true do local changed text, changed = text:gsub("^(%-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2") if changed == 0 then break end end return text end
local function gold_value(label) if label == "TP" then return nil end local number = tonumber(label:match("^([%d.]+)")) or 0 if label:find("mil", 1, true) then return number * 1000000 end if label:find("k", 1, true) then return number * 1000 end return number end
local function compact_number(number) number = tonumber(number) or 0 local divisor, suffix = 1, "" if math.abs(number) >= 1000000000 then divisor, suffix = 1000000000, "B" elseif math.abs(number) >= 1000000 then divisor, suffix = 1000000, "M" elseif math.abs(number) >= 1000 then divisor, suffix = 1000, "K" end local scaled = number / divisor local text if divisor == 1 then text = tostring(math.floor(scaled + 0.5)) elseif math.abs(scaled) >= 100 then text = string.format("%.0f", scaled) elseif math.abs(scaled) >= 10 then text = string.format("%.1f", scaled) else text = string.format("%.2f", scaled) end text = text:gsub("(%..-)0+$", "%1"):gsub("%.$", "") return text .. suffix end
local function normalize_sale_currency(value) local currency = tostring(value or "gold"):lower() if currency == "qp" then return "qp" end return "gold" end
local function add_sales_average(averages, item_name, average, times_sold, currency) local key = normalize(item_name) if not A.canonical_by_key[key] then return end average = tonumber(average) or 0 times_sold = tonumber(times_sold) or 0 if average <= 0 or times_sold <= 0 then return end averages[key] = { average = average, times_sold = times_sold, currency = normalize_sale_currency(currency), } end
local function read_lsqlite_averages(connection, sqlite_module) local statement = connection:prepare( "SELECT item_name,avg_price,times_sold,currency " .. "FROM market_items WHERE item_name LIKE '(aarchaeology) %'") if not statement then return nil end local averages = {} local row_code = sqlite_module and sqlite_module.ROW or 100 while statement:step() == row_code do add_sales_average(averages, statement:get_value(0), statement:get_value(1), statement:get_value(2), statement:get_value(3)) end statement:finalize() return averages end
local function read_live_mudlet_db_averages() local api = rawget(_G, "db") local schema = type(MM) == "table" and MM.mdb and MM.mdb.market_items or nil if type(api) ~= "table" or type(api.fetch) ~= "function" or not schema then return nil end local ok, rows = pcall(function() if type(api.like) == "function" and schema.item_name then return api:fetch(schema, api:like(schema.item_name, "(aarchaeology) %")) end return api:fetch(schema) end) if not ok or type(rows) ~= "table" then return nil end local averages = {} for _, row in ipairs(rows) do add_sales_average(averages, row.item_name, row.avg_price, row.times_sold, row.currency) end return averages end
-- Every mbot access below is SELECT/fetch only. We never call MM.open_db(), -- db:create(), or any INSERT/UPDATE helper. function A.read_mbot_averages() if type(MM) == "table" and MM.db and type(MM.db.prepare) == "function" then local ok, averages = pcall(read_lsqlite_averages, MM.db, MM.sqlite3) if ok and type(averages) == "table" then return averages, "mbot-live" end end
local averages = read_live_mudlet_db_averages() if type(averages) == "table" then return averages, "mbot-live" end
local file = io.open(A.mbot_db_file, "rb") if not file then return nil, "missing" end file:close()
local ok, sqlite_module = pcall(require, "lsqlite3") if not ok then ok, sqlite_module = pcall(require, "lsqlite3complete") end if not ok or type(sqlite_module) ~= "table" or type(sqlite_module.open) ~= "function" or sqlite_module.OPEN_READONLY == nil then return nil, "readonly-driver-unavailable" end
local opened, connection = pcall(sqlite_module.open, A.mbot_db_file, sqlite_module.OPEN_READONLY) if not opened or not connection then return nil, "readonly-open-failed" end local read_ok, result = pcall(read_lsqlite_averages, connection, sqlite_module) pcall(function() connection:close() end) if read_ok and type(result) == "table" then return result, "mbot-file-readonly" end return nil, "readonly-query-failed" end
function A.sales_snapshot(force_refresh) local now = os.time() if not force_refresh and type(A.sales_cache) == "table" and now - (tonumber(A.sales_cache.loaded_at) or 0) < 30 then return A.sales_cache end -- mbot is optional. Keep all callers working even if its globals, schema, -- SQLite driver, or database file are unavailable or malformed. local ok, averages, source = pcall(A.read_mbot_averages) if not ok then averages, source = nil, "unavailable" end A.sales_cache = { available = type(averages) == "table", averages = averages or {}, source = source or "missing", loaded_at = now, } return A.sales_cache end
local function fallback_cost(piece) local multiplier = tonumber(A.settings.fallback_multiplier) or 5 local number = A.number_by_name[piece] local value = number and A.values[number] or nil if value == "TP" then return { amount = multiplier, currency = "tp", source = "fallback" } end return { amount = multiplier * (gold_value(value or "") or 0), currency = "gold", source = "fallback", } end
function A.cost_info_for_piece(piece, snapshot) snapshot = snapshot or A.sales_snapshot(false) local row = snapshot.available and snapshot.averages[normalize(piece)] or nil if row then return { amount = row.average, currency = row.currency, times_sold = row.times_sold, source = "average", } end return fallback_cost(piece) end
function A.average_tag_for_piece(piece) local snapshot = A.sales_snapshot(false) local row = snapshot.available and snapshot.averages[normalize(piece)] or nil if not row then return nil end local currency = row.currency == "qp" and "QP" or "gold" return "avg " .. compact_number(row.average) .. " " .. currency end
function A.remaining_cost() if A.scan_in_progress then cecho("<yellow>[m_aarchaeology] The bag scan is still running; try aarch cost again when the report finishes.\n") return end if not A.ran or A.scan_failed then cecho("<yellow>[m_aarchaeology] Run <cyan>aarch report<yellow> first so the remaining-cost total uses your current collection.\n") return end
local missing = {} for _, piece in ipairs(A.pieces) do if not A.owned[piece] then missing[#missing + 1] = piece end end if #missing == 0 then cecho("<yellow>[m_aarchaeology] Remaining estimated cost: <green>0 - collection complete!\n") return end
local snapshot = A.sales_snapshot(true) local totals = { gold = 0, qp = 0, tp = 0 } local average_count, fallback_count = 0, 0 local entries = {} for _, piece in ipairs(missing) do local info = A.cost_info_for_piece(piece, snapshot) entries[#entries + 1] = { piece = piece, info = info } totals[info.currency] = (totals[info.currency] or 0) + (tonumber(info.amount) or 0) if info.source == "average" then average_count = average_count + 1 else fallback_count = fallback_count + 1 end end
local function estimated_cost_text(info) if info.currency == "qp" then return comma_number(info.amount) .. " QP" end if info.currency == "tp" then return compact_number(info.amount) .. " TP" end return comma_number(info.amount) .. " Gold" end
cecho(string.format("\n<yellow>[m_aarchaeology] Cost breakdown for <white>%d<yellow> missing piece%s:<reset>\n", #missing, #missing == 1 and "" or "s")) cecho("<yellow>" .. string.format("%-34s %8s %-18s %21s", "Piece", "Turn-in", "Pricing", "Estimated cost") .. "<reset>\n") for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do local piece = entry.piece local info = entry.info local number = A.number_by_name[piece] local piece_cell = string.format("[%2d] %s", number, piece) local turnin_cell = "[" .. A.values[number] .. "]" local source_cell if info.source == "average" then source_cell = string.format("avg (%d sale%s)", tonumber(info.times_sold) or 0, tonumber(info.times_sold) == 1 and "" or "s") else source_cell = "fallback x" .. multiplier_text(A.settings.fallback_multiplier) end cecho("<white>" .. string.format("%-34s", piece_cell)) cecho("<cyan>" .. string.format(" %8s", turnin_cell)) cecho((info.source == "average" and "<yellow>" or "<gray>") .. string.format(" %-18s", source_cell)) cecho("<white>" .. string.format(" %21s", estimated_cost_text(info)) .. "<reset>\n") end
cecho(string.format("<yellow>Total estimated cost for <white>%d<yellow> piece%s: ", #missing, #missing == 1 and "" or "s")) local parts = {} if totals.gold > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = "<white>" .. comma_number(totals.gold) .. " <gold>Gold" end if totals.qp > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = "<white>" .. comma_number(totals.qp) .. " <green>QP" end if totals.tp > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = "<white>" .. compact_number(totals.tp) .. " <cyan>TP" end cecho(table.concat(parts, "<yellow> and ")) echo("\n") cecho(string.format("<gray> %d mbot average%s; %d fallback%s at <white>x%s<gray>.\n", average_count, average_count == 1 and "" or "s", fallback_count, fallback_count == 1 and "" or "s", multiplier_text(A.settings.fallback_multiplier))) if not snapshot.available then cecho("<yellow> mbot sales database unavailable; all missing pieces used the configured fallback.\n") end end
function A.report() local missing = {} for _, piece in ipairs(A.pieces) do if not A.owned[piece] then missing[#missing + 1] = piece end end
cecho("\n<magenta>------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n") if #missing == 0 then cecho("<cyan> You have all 50 <red>(<yellow>Aarchaeology<red>) <cyan>pieces. Nice work!\n") else cecho(string.format("<cyan> You are missing <white>%d <red>(<yellow>Aarchaeology<red>) <cyan>piece%s:\n", #missing, #missing == 1 and "" or "s")) cecho("<magenta>------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n") local piece_width, value_width = 34, 8 local function echo_missing_entry(piece) local number = A.number_by_name[piece] local label = string.format("[%2d] ", number) local piece_cell = label .. piece local value = A.values[number] local value_cell = "[" .. value .. "]" cecho("<gray>" .. label .. "<white>" .. piece) echo(string.rep(" ", math.max(1, piece_width - #piece_cell))) echo(string.rep(" ", math.max(1, value_width - #value_cell))) cecho("<magenta>[<cyan>" .. value .. "<magenta>]") end for index = 1, #missing, 2 do echo_missing_entry(missing[index]) if missing[index + 1] then echo(" ") echo_missing_entry(missing[index + 1]) end echo("\n") end end
cecho("<magenta>------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n") cecho("<cyan> Duplicates:\n") cecho("<magenta>------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n") local duplicate_rows = 0 local total_gold, total_tp, loose_pieces = 0, 0, 0 for _, piece in ipairs(A.pieces) do local number = A.number_by_name[piece] local pc = tonumber(A.piece_counts[piece]) or 0 local pam = tonumber(A.pamphlet_counts[piece]) or 0 local descriptions = {} if pc > 0 and pam > 0 then descriptions[#descriptions + 1] = count_label(pc, "Extra Piece", "Extra Pieces") descriptions[#descriptions + 1] = count_label(pam, "Pamphlet", "Pamphlets") elseif pc > 1 then descriptions[#descriptions + 1] = count_label(pc - 1, "Extra Piece", "Extra Pieces") elseif pam > 1 then descriptions[#descriptions + 1] = count_label(pam - 1, "Extra Pamphlet", "Extra Pamphlets") end if #descriptions > 0 then duplicate_rows = duplicate_rows + 1 cecho(string.format("<gray>[#%2d] <white>%-28s <magenta>- <yellow>%s <magenta>[<cyan>%s<magenta>]\n", number, piece, table.concat(descriptions, ", "), A.values[number])) end
if pc > 0 then loose_pieces = loose_pieces + pc if A.values[number] == "TP" then total_tp = total_tp + pc else total_gold = total_gold + pc * (gold_value(A.values[number]) or 0) end end end if duplicate_rows == 0 then cecho("<yellow> None.\n") end cecho("<magenta>------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n") if loose_pieces > 0 then cecho(string.format("<light_gray> Value of <white>%d <red>(<yellow>Aarchaeology<red>) <light_gray>pieces not turned in yet: ", loose_pieces)) if total_gold > 0 then cecho("<white>" .. comma_number(total_gold) .. " <gold>Gold") end if total_gold > 0 and total_tp > 0 then cecho("<light_gray> and ") end if total_tp > 0 then cecho("<white>" .. tostring(total_tp) .. " <green>TP") end echo("\n") end cecho("<magenta>------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n") end
function A.run_report() local bags = split_bags(A.settings.bags) if #bags == 0 then cecho("<red>[m_aarchaeology] No bags configured. Use: aarch bag [id/keyword]\n") return end A.clear_inventory() A.scan_in_progress = true A.scan_failed = false A.ran = true for _, bag in ipairs(bags) do if bag:lower() == "vault list" then send("vault list") else send("look in " .. bag) end end send("echo @YLooked in Aarch Bags!", false) end
function A.cant_look() if not A.scan_in_progress then return end A.scan_failed = true cecho("<cyan>[m_aarchaeology] You cannot run an Aarch report while sleeping!\n") end
function A.done_look() if not A.scan_in_progress then return end A.scan_in_progress = false if not A.scan_failed then A.commit_inventory() A.report() else A.restore_saved_inventory() end end
function A.help() cecho("\n<gold>m_aarchaeology commands<reset>\n\n") cecho("<cyan>aarch report<reset>\n<gray> Scan configured bags, save the inventory, and report missing pieces and duplicates.<reset>\n") cecho("<cyan>aarch cost<reset>\n<gray> Total missing pieces using mbot averages and the no-history fallback.<reset>\n") cecho("<cyan>aarch multiplier [number]<reset>\n<gray> Show or set the no-history fallback multiplier.<reset>\n") cecho("<cyan>aarch bag [id/keyword,...]<reset>\n<gray> Show or set one or more bags.<reset>\n") cecho("<cyan>aarch sound on|off<reset>\n<gray> Toggle the Professor alert.<reset>\n") cecho("<cyan>aarch sound [file]<reset>\n<gray> Set the alert sound file.<reset>\n") cecho("<yellow>Cost warning: mbot average prices require a configured mbot sales database.<reset>\n") cecho("<gray> Without mbot, aarch cost safely uses the configured fallback multiplier.<reset>\n") end
function A.on_disconnect() A.scan_in_progress = false A.scan_failed = false A.restore_saved_inventory() end
function A.register_handlers() if type(killAnonymousEventHandler) == "function" and type(A.handler_ids) == "table" then for _, id in ipairs(A.handler_ids) do pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, id) end end A.handler_ids = {} if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler) ~= "function" then return end local function register(event_name, callback) local id = registerAnonymousEventHandler(event_name, callback) if id ~= nil then A.handler_ids[#A.handler_ids + 1] = id end end register("sysDisconnectionEvent", "m_aarchaeology_OnDisconnect") end
function A.init() A.rebuild_indexes() A.clear_inventory() A.scan_in_progress = false A.scan_failed = false A.ran = false A.sales_cache = nil A.load_settings() A.register_handlers() cecho(string.format("<gold>[m_aarchaeology] <green>Loaded v%s. <yellow>Type <cyan>aarch help<yellow> for commands.\n", A.version)) cecho(string.format("<yellow>[m_aarchaeology] Professor alert: <cyan>%s<yellow>.\n", A.settings.sounds)) cecho("<yellow>[m_aarchaeology] Missing-history fallback: <white>x" .. multiplier_text(A.settings.fallback_multiplier) .. "<yellow>.\n") if A.has_saved_inventory then cecho("<yellow>[m_aarchaeology] Restored inventory from the last successful report scan.\n") end A.show_bags() end
function m_aarchaeology_Alias_Report() A.run_report() end function m_aarchaeology_Alias_Cost() A.remaining_cost() end function m_aarchaeology_Alias_Multiplier(matches) A.set_multiplier(matches and matches[2] or "") end function m_aarchaeology_Alias_Help() A.help() end function m_aarchaeology_Alias_Bag(matches) A.set_bags(matches and matches[2] or "") end function m_aarchaeology_Alias_SoundToggle(matches) A.set_sound_toggle(matches and matches[2] or "") end function m_aarchaeology_Alias_SoundShow() A.show_sound() end function m_aarchaeology_Alias_SoundTest() A.test_sound() end function m_aarchaeology_Alias_SoundFile(matches) A.set_sound_file(matches and matches[2] or "") end
function m_aarchaeology_TR_Professor() A.play_professor_sound() end function m_aarchaeology_TR_Pamphlet(matches) A.capture_pamphlet(matches and matches[2], matches and matches[3]) end function m_aarchaeology_TR_Piece(matches) A.capture_piece(matches and matches[2], matches and matches[3], line) end function m_aarchaeology_TR_Market(matches) A.append_sale_details(line, matches and matches[2]) end function m_aarchaeology_TR_Auction(matches) A.append_sale_details(line, matches and matches[2]) end function m_aarchaeology_TR_LBid(matches) A.append_sale_details(line, matches and matches[3]) end function m_aarchaeology_TR_Bid(matches) A.append_sale_details(line, matches and matches[3]) end function m_aarchaeology_TR_MarketList(matches) A.market_list(matches and matches[3], matches and matches[2], line) end function m_aarchaeology_TR_CantLook() A.cant_look() end function m_aarchaeology_TR_Done() A.done_look() end function m_aarchaeology_OnDisconnect() A.on_disconnect() end
A.init()
